scope: First Hikari introduction in Ryu, the mandatory event battle, then invitation and skipping Chapter 1. Source evidence for a four-member party; no battle or map draw total is hardcoded.

battle.label_resolution: Event cmd600 opt[0] -> EncountVolumeData -> selected EncounterList row -> BattleEncounterData -> EnemyGroupData. ENM/ENC/ENG are distinct table keys.
battle.continuation: Victory resumes MS_KEN_00_0300 through EventManagerBP.UpdateBattleStart; do not independently FinishPre the suspended MS_KEN_00_0100 before this continuation.
battle.field_return: On Shown Field After Battle Impl: EncountType1 selects720, then the victory path1425 ->1587 RefreshPartyCharacterFormation ->754 ->826 ResetEncountStep. This real field-return counter reset is BEFORE the0300 continuation and distinct from its later FinishPre at179.

party_join.replacement: Explicit player choice is required at the full-party change menu; do not append a fifth active member or silently select who is benched.
party_join.callback: EventManagerBP.StartAddMemberEnd reads MainMemberID. UpdateAddMemberEnd can open OpenPartyCharacterChangeMenu and then checks the chosen active membership.
party_join.native_join: JoinPlayerCharacter f0d6d0 adds the newly recruited character to the bench when MainMemberID is full; f0c7f0 writes the resulting party arrays.
party_join.party_change: PartyList.RefreshMainMember in AddFriendMode invokes RefreshBarChangeCharacter rather than the ordinary RefreshSpawnCurrentLevel. Recompute active-party support skills after the chosen swap; do not keep an Evasive Maneuvers flag if its equipped character leaves the active party.
party_join.progression_limit: Native join array updates do not themselves write EXP/level. Audit evidence here does not infer an average-party recruitment level.

completion_callback.effect: The actual NO/SkipPrologueReminiscence completion applies the inclusive on/off ranges and the one-time ClearDifficultyPoint. Mere generic point bookkeeping must not apply these flags.
completion_callback.equipment: f15190 removes all equipment, grants the fixed skip-prologue items and calls f35f50 (SetFirstEquipment). Those operations must not be mistaken for an average-party EXP or level grant.
